events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On September 13, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur died in Las Vegas six days after being shot in a drive-by.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost one of hip-hop's most profound voices. Tupac's legacy continues to resonate, his lyrics as powerful today as they ever were. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: His music changed everything. Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like "Come Together" and "Something".

angles.name: Crossing the Classic
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those songs – pure magic. Still sounds as fresh as ever. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock 'n' roll legend, still bringing that distinctive edge to the airwaves. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic peace anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975, four years after its original album release.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A song that still inspires hope and reflection around the world.

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years On
events.blurb: The revolutionary first-generation Apple iPod, which transformed how we listen to music, was released on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, this little device changed how we carried our music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite 007?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend and peace activist John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and timeless music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Silly Walks & Laughter
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album,' was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wisdom
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A bold, experimental statement that still fascinates. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant step in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, showcasing a new depth and sophistication. A pivotal album that changed pop music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, the music world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Let's take a moment to reflect on his incredible impact.
